<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star: Conference Room''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊デス・スター：作戦会議室</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、フォース消耗に＋1。加えて「発射準備開始せよ」の合計値から1を引ける。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、「発射準備開始せよ」の合計値に1を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Death-Star-Conference-Room-PSA-161939287.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star: operations conference room.

'''Light Side:'''
If you control here, Force drains are +1. In addition, you may subtract 1 from the total of Commence Primary Ignition.

'''Dark Side:'''
If you control here, add 1 to the total of Commence Primary Ignition.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 作戦会議室. Japanese Light needs control for Force drain +1.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star: Conference Room]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
